summary: Validates a season-race section and a string-keyed list entry, then copies the referenced data entry into a caller buffer a1 with capacity a2-1 and null-terminates. Returns 0 on success, 1 if the section or key lookup fails. A widespread resource-string loader helper (AIDatabase_Init, TrackConfig, PitStopOrderLoader, SpecialFX_Init, HDV parsing).

operations.description: if (!SeasonRacesSectionFinder(a4)) return 1; validate section lookup fails -> error
v4 = StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(a3); look up entry by string key
if (!v4) return 1; key not found -> error
v5 = DataEntryAccessor(v4); obtain data entry from node
sub_587DD0(a1, v5, a2 - 1); copy entry into caller buffer with capacity a2-1
return 0 on success, 1 on section/key validation failure
